description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -  Pahalamakndura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420500
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details about parcel numbers, extent, ownership, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, specifically title settlement determinations for various land parcels in different villages, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
